query:
SELECT pc.mes, pc.ano, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN idi.equipamentoTag IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(idi.valor AS DECIMAL(12,2)) ELSE 0 END) as totalDespesas,
  COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM item_despesa_importado idi
INNER JOIN periodo_custo pc ON idi.periodoCustoId = pc.id
WHERE pc.mes IN (2,3) AND pc.ano = 2026
GROUP BY pc.mes, pc.ano;
